subject: ci: Add cuda backend validation for llama.cpp on Linux using self-hosted amd64 and arm64 runners (#3714)
summary: Adds a Linux build (build-linux) and CUDA validation (validate-linux) job matrix for llama.cpp on the self-hosted DGX Spark ARM64 (sjlab-dgx-spark-01) and RTX 5070 x64 (sjlab-rtx-5070-fractal-01) runners in .github/workflows/validate_llamacpp.yml, including sm_121 (GB10) support, a new matrix.lite_only flag for the RTX 5070, an extracted update_backend_versions.py helper script, and updated docs/dev/self-hosted-runners.md.
verdict_reason: This is CI-only infrastructure work with no user-visible surface, all CI checks passed, and it was reviewed and approved by a maintainer with CI subject-area expertise.
